skill.name: giil
skill.description: Download full-resolution images from public iCloud, Dropbox, Google Photos, and Google Drive share links for AI-assisted visual debugging.
skill.summary: Fetch cloud-shared images into local files for Claude Code, Codex, and remote debugging workflows.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline backticks, example URLs, or documented cache paths. The confirmed risks are the remote installer commands piped into bash, direct executable download from GitHub, sudo package installation examples, and local debug artifacts that may preserve sensitive page content.

remediation.issue: Remote install scripts are piped directly into bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell instructions with download, inspect, checksum verify, then execute steps. Prefer signed releases or package managers.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes sudo package installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Clearly separate optional system package installation from normal use, and tell users to verify packages and run with least privilege.

remediation.issue: Manual install downloads an executable directly into a user bin directory.
remediation.suggestion: Provide checksums, signatures, release artifacts, and version pinning before instructing users to make the file executable.

remediation.issue: Debug mode can write screenshots, HTML, and traces that may include sensitive content.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to store debug artifacts in a private directory and delete them after troubleshooting.

content.user_title: Download Shared Images for AI Debugging
content.value_statement: Remote AI sessions often need screenshots or photos that only exist behind cloud share links. This skill helps fetch public shared images into local files so Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can inspect them.
actual_capabilities: Downloads public image share links from iCloud, Dropbox, Google Photos, and Google Drive.
Uses browser automation and network interception for JavaScript-heavy photo pages.
Can return file paths, metadata, base64 data, or resolved CDN URLs.
Supports album downloads with indexed output names.
Handles HEIC or HEIF conversion when platform tools are available.
Creates debug screenshots, DOM files, or Playwright traces when troubleshooting is enabled.
limitations: Private or login-protected links require the owner to enable public sharing first.
First use may download a large Playwright Chromium browser cache.
HEIC conversion on Linux requires extra system packages.
The documented install flow includes remote shell installation patterns that need review.

use_cases.title: Debug mobile UI screenshots remotely
use_cases.description: Download an iPhone screenshot from a public iCloud link into a remote Claude Code session.
use_cases.target_user: Software engineers using SSH or cloud workspaces

use_cases.title: Collect shared photo evidence for bug reports
use_cases.description: Save images from cloud share links as local files with metadata for issue analysis.

use_cases.title: Batch review shared image albums
use_cases.description: Download every public image in an album and preserve ordering with indexed filenames.
use_cases.target_user: Researchers and product teams reviewing image sets

prompt_templates.title: Download one shared image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for one public cloud share link.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an image for Claude Code
prompt_templates.scenario: Return metadata that an AI assistant can consume.

prompt_templates.scenario: Collect multiple public images for review.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot a failed capture

output_examples.input: A public iCloud photo share link from a mobile screenshot.
output_examples.output: A local image path plus metadata such as image dimensions, file size, source platform, and capture method.

output_examples.input: A public shared album link with several images.
output_examples.output: A sequence of locally saved image paths with numbered filenames that preserve album order.

output_examples.input: A failed or expired cloud share link.
output_examples.output: A clear error category such as authentication required, not found, timeout, or unsupported content type.

best_practices: Use public share links only when you have permission to access and process the images.
Prefer JSON output when another AI tool needs file metadata and capture details.
Review remote install commands before running them, especially commands piped into a shell.
anti_patterns: Do not use private or restricted links unless the owner has approved public access.
Do not upload downloaded images to external APIs unless the image owner permits it.
Do not run remote installation commands blindly in shared or production environments.

faq.question: Does this skill work with private photo libraries?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for public share links and reports an authentication error when login is required.

faq.question: Why does it need Playwright?
faq.answer: Some cloud photo pages load images through JavaScript, so a browser is needed to capture the real image response.

faq.question: Can it download an entire album?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented album mode clicks through shared album thumbnails and saves each captured image.

faq.question: Can it preserve original quality?
faq.answer: Yes, when the download button or full-resolution network response is available. Fallback screenshots may be lower fidelity.

faq.question: What are the main security concerns?
faq.answer: The documentation includes curl-to-shell installation commands and privileged package installation examples.

faq.question: Does it send telemetry?
faq.answer: The documentation claims no telemetry, but users should still review the actual installer and executable before running them.
